caption_L1: Here a bar plot is titled Most popular products purchased in online stores during the coronavirus (COVID-19) epidemic in Poland as a monthly change in the number of BLIK transactions between February and April 2020 , by e-commerce category. The x-axis measures e-commerce category on categorical scale starting with Bookmaker's betting and ending with Tickets/transport while the y-axis plots March to February 2020 with categorical scale from −1 to 3.
caption_L2L3: Household appliances were the most popular products purchased in online stores. Tickets/Transport was the least popular category during the period.
